topic: Migration to Britain c1000 to c2010
subject: history

items.q: Is migration to Britain a recent, post-1945 phenomenon?
items.correct: No — Britain has experienced migration for over a thousand years.
items.why: Romans, Saxons, Vikings, Normans, Huguenots and many others came over centuries.

items.q: Have migrants come to Britain only for economic reasons?
items.correct: No — also for asylum, persecution, family, empire ties and conflict.
items.why: Reasons for migration are varied and have changed over time.

items.q: Was migration to Britain always welcomed without tension?
items.correct: No — migrants made major contributions but often also faced hostility.
items.random_wrong: Migrants had no impact on Britain.
items.why: Attitudes varied across periods and communities.
